description: This file implements session management using a database backend for the ADOdb PHP library. It includes functions to serialize/unserialize session data, regenerate session IDs, create session tables, and a class 'ADODB_Session' for database connection handling, session data reading/writing, destruction, and garbage collection.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: Class managing database-backed PHP sessions, including connection setup, session data read/write, destroy, and garbage collection methods.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Get or set the database driver used for session storage.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Get or set the database hostname.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Get or set the database username.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Get or set the database password.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Get or set the database name.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Get or set the persistence mode for the database connection.

methods.name: lifetime
methods.description: Get or set session lifetime.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Get or set debug mode.

methods.name: expireNotify
methods.description: Get or set the garbage collection callback function.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Get or set the name of the session table.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Get or set the optimization mode for the session table.

methods.name: syncSeconds
methods.description: Deprecated method returning 0; kept for backward compatibility.

methods.name: clob
methods.description: Get or set whether CLOBs are used for session data storage.

methods.name: dataFieldName
methods.description: Deprecated method returning empty string; retained for backward compatibility.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Get or set the session data filter functions.

methods.name: encryptionKey
methods.description: Get or set the encryption key used for encrypted sessions.

methods.name: _conn
methods.description: Private method to retrieve the database connection instance.

methods.name: _crc
methods.description: Private method to manage CRC hash of session data.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initialize session handler by registering methods with PHP's session set save handler.

methods.name: _sessionKey
methods.description: Generate encryption key for session data encryption.

methods.name: _dumprs
methods.description: Debugging helper to dump the recordset of session data.

methods.name: isConnectionMysql
methods.description: Check if the current session connection uses MySQL.

methods.name: isConnectionPostgres
methods.description: Check if the current session connection uses PostgreSQL.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configure the database connection parameters for session management.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establish a connection to the database for session handling.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the session database connection.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write session data to the database for a given session key.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy the session data associated with a given key.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Perform garbage collection to clear expired sessions.
